To redraw a line in place, use the `Live` display: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst

Rich removes carriage returns from text (`STRIP_CONTROL_CODES` in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/control.py), so `\r` does not move the cursor back as it does with the built-in `print()`. The `flush` argument of `rich.print` has no effect because Rich always flushes; that does not change how `\r` is handled.

For further questions, please use Discussions: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions
